settings.content: Controls the text shown by the image-with-text banner's dynamic sale option. Pick the language on the block itself via its "Dynamic sale language" dropdown - each language below is a plain text field, not JSON, so there's no syntax to get wrong.

In every "Heading template" field, use [sale_name] as a placeholder - it's replaced with the current month's sale name (in capitals). Every "Sale names by month" field must have exactly 12 comma-separated values, in order: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec.
